pr_body:

#### What this PR does / why we need it:

This is the cause of a very high flake rate.

#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

Fixes #119493

#### Special notes for your reviewer:

As [noted](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/119493#issuecomment-1645979409) by @liggitt the last time a field was added here, the same thing happened - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/107954

#### Does this PR introduce a user-facing change?

No, this is a bug in a field added in 1.28

```release-note
NONE
```

/priority critically-urgent
/sig api-machinery
/cc @liggitt @cici37 @pacoxu

Easy to reproduce on local env.

~~After some testing, I find https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/118990/ causing the flake.~~

My mistake, not this pr.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/118041 is the root cause of the flake.
/cc @cici37  @jpbetz  @liggitt

~~I don't understand how https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/118041 would cause label/shortname roundtrip flakes~~

I didn't read far enough, the error was:

`CustomResourceDefinition: fuzzing a copy altered the original`

deepcopy is manual for jsonprops
```
if in.XValidations != nil {
        in, out := &in.XValidations, &out.XValidations
        *out = make([]ValidationRule, len(*in))
        copy(*out, *in)
    }
```
was the manual impl

that's no longer valid since we have a pointer now

/assign @jpbetz @cici37
Working on a targeted fix now
(the last time a field was added here, the same thing happened - https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/107954)

Confirmed that the deep copy fix works as expected:

```
go test k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver/pkg/apis/apiextensions/install -count=10
ok      k8s.io/apiextensions-apiserver/pkg/apis/apiextensions/install    0.463s
```

I'll send out a PR in a moment.
